apps.name: qBitControl
apps.subtitle: Remote client for qBittorrent.
apps.localizedDescription: qBitControl is the definitive remote client for managing your qBittorrent downloads on iOS devices. With qBitControl, you can effortlessly add torrents, browse files, monitor your download progress, and manage your torrents, all while enjoying real-time statistics and a native iOS user interface.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Release Notes

- Reduced Data Usage: Network traffic was reduced by 93% due to optimized data syncing.
- Custom Headers: Added the ability to specify custom HTTP headers for your server connections - important for Zero-Trust services. 
- Limit Configuration: You can now configure precise speed/seeding/share limits for torrents. 
- Self-Signed Certificate Support: Added full support for untrusted and self-signed SSL certificates. 
- In-App Logs: Added a built-in log viewer to review and easily share system events. 
- And many more...

Check out the full changelog on Patreon!

Features
- Resume current tasks (by @kambala-decapitator)
- Sanitize server URL for trailing slashes when adding a server (by @danpiths)

Bug Fixes
- Resolve single task deletion from context menu and use standard alert (#92) (by @Michael-128)
- Fix stats showing up as zeros on qBittorrent >5.2 (by @Michael-128)
- Fix peers JSON decoding (by @kambala-decapitator)
- Fix ServersHelper thread safety warning (by @Michael-128)

- Automated build setup & pipeline fixes
- Remove obsolete Xcode workspace (by @kambala-decapitator)
- Bump version to 1.3.5 (build 19)
